first_step_precision: Rounded to 4 decimals here; exact original floats are in SHA-256-pinned artifact
negative_control: With zero visitors, halving viable outcross offspring has exactly identical paired occupancy outcomes and no outcross recruits (48 of 48 paired draws at each K).
scientific_result: At the prespecified engineered low ovule budget 3 and 80 updates, K8 has a terminal-occupancy floor (0/48 in every arm). This prevents identifying a nonzero K8 gate sensitivity from these outcomes; it must not be called a biological absence of seed-viability effects. K48 occupancy is rare and declines to 0/48 under half-self in both fixed synthetic visitor regimes. The original source first-step assurance-high expected direction is positive, while no K8 population survives to the 80-update endpoint in the sampled demographic paths. This is only a synthetic example of distinct conditional gene-transmission and demographic endpoints, not proof of natural fitness discordance.
restrictions: One static visitor condition per regime, no independent ecological history sample
Demographic repeats conditional on the same fixed visitors; no ecological bootstrap
No A/I assigned expression schedules, so none of these effects estimates PR451's primary tau(K8)-tau(K48)
No cumulative self recruit total used as causal mediator
No inference that 0/48 is exactly zero true persistence probability
No confirmatory data, no natural islands, no absolute fitness inference
